texts.value: Mitochondrial inner membrane adapter protein essential for terminal erythroid differentiation and heme biosynthesis (PubMed:26968549, PubMed:28594398). Facilitates formation of an oligomeric mitochondrial iron transport complex required for iron acquisition during heme synthesis, although it does not function as a direct iron transporter (By similarity). Directly interacts with terminal heme synthesis enzymes PPOX and FECH to enhance ferrochelatase activity and couple iron import with heme synthesis (By similarity). Regulates mitochondrial energy metabolism through interaction with ATP synthase subunits (PubMed:36374104)

Interacts with PPOX and FECH to form an oligomeric iron transport complex required for heme synthesis (By similarity). Interacts with multiple subunits of mitochondrial ATP synthase including ATP5F1A and ATP5F1B; the interaction regulates mitochondrial energy metabolism (PubMed:36374104)
Expressed in late erythroblast differentiation stages (PubMed:26968549). Underexpressed in ovarian cancer epithelia cells compared with normal human ovarian surface epithelia (PubMed:28594398)
Up-regulated by the erythroid transcription factor GATA1 (PubMed:26968549)
